buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1.The vehicles to be provided must be One Toyota Innova Crysta and Three Mahindra Bolero and of at leas t manufacturing year 2021. 2. The vehicles deployed for the contract should not be owned by any employee of this office or their depe ndents. If there is any contravention of this clause, the contract will be terminated immediately and the Se curity Deposit will be forfeited. 3. The vehicle deployed for the contract shall not be older than as provided above. 4. The vehicle deployed shall be well maintained, in good running condition and road worthy to ensure sm ooth and trouble free service during the entire contract period. 5. The deployment of vehicle shall be punctual always. Late reporting and absence will attract penalty as p

er clause 24 of Instructions to Bidders. 6. Any unauthorized journey undertaken by the driver / contractor during the contract period shall not be a llowed. 7. While deploying the vehicle, the contractor shall always ensure the following: a. Valid and relevant documents for the vehicle and driver viz., Registration Certificate, Tax paid Challan / endorsement, insurance, fitness certificate, driving license, commercial use permit, emission test certificat e etc. b. Vehicle shall be in full preparedness for the full day service including the fuel in the tank, preparedness of the driver and reasonable money with the driver for meeting contingency requirements. c. A mobile phone with the driver in working and charged condition. d. A first aid kit in the vehicle. e. Good upholstery for the seats and with cotton cloth covering on the top. The cotton cloth shall be regula rly washed and maintained in hygienic condition. f. Vehicle should be washed daily and maintained cleanly both exteriors and interiors. g. Essential minimum spares viz., fan belt, stepney (spare tyre) properly inflated, spare bulb & fuses, jack, standard tools and tackles to attend the emergencies. 8. Trip/duty sheet booklet should be properly filled along with acknowledgement while performing the duty . The details as recorded in the signed trip/duty sheet shall be made available for preparing the bills. 9. The contractor shall not assign and/or sublet the work or any part of it to any other person or party. Inst ances found, if any, shall be viewed seriously and the contract is liable for termination and black listing of t he contractor. No correspondence shall be entertained in this regard and the decision taken by Deputy Co mmissioner, Chandigarh is final and shall be binding on the contractor. 10. This office reserves the right to check the speedometer / odometer of the deployed vehicle at any point of time and if it is found inaccurate / tampered, suitable action deemed fit will be taken. Repeated offence may lead to termination of contract and forfeiting of security deposit. 11. The contractor shall be held responsible for any breach of the term s and conditions of the contract. 12. Accidents during the course of the work shall be reported by the contractor / driver immediately to this office. Contractor shall submit det ailed report of any such accident or incident. 13. The contractor will operate their vehicles entirely at their own risk and this office shall not be held resp onsible for any damage / losses incurred both for the vehicle or persons traveling in the vehicle any time . 14. The contractor shall ensure that all their vehicles under the contract are covered by a comprehensive i nsurance by a leading / reputed insurance provider. The insurance policy shall cover compensation for the loss / damage to the vehicle, driver and co passengers as well. Under no circumstance shall this office be li able to compensate any loss / da mage that may be caused to / by the vehicle while engaged in discharge of the contractor’s obligations under this contract. 15. As and when required clearance from RTO or any other authority concerned and compliance of any oth er legal formalities connected with the contract have to be arranged by contractor at his own cost. This off ice will not take any responsibility and will not bear any addition al expenses in this regard. 16. No advance payment shall be made under any circumstances. 17. If the contractor fails to complete its work as per terms of fails to comply with the directions, then pena lty @ Rs.4000/- per item per hour s hall be levied. Excise & Taxation Commissioner, Excise & Taxation Dep artment, Chandigarh shall be at liberty to make alternative arrangement, the expenditure for such arrange ments and for the loss/damage incurred as a result of such non-compliance will be deducting from the run ning bill or security deposit of the contractor. Excise & Taxation Com missioner, Excise & Taxation Depart ment, Chandigarh reserves the right to determine the cost of deduction at its sole direction. Penalty is subj ect to force majeure condition like accident, public unrest, natural calamities etc. at the direction and verifi cation of this office. 18. In the event of any dispute or difference whatsoever arising under t his contract or in connection there

with including any dispute relating to existing meaning and interpretation of this contract, the same shall b e referred to the arbitrator appointed by Excise & Taxation Commissioner, Excise & Taxation Department, UT, Chandigarh whose decision shall be final and binding. The proceeding of the arbitration shall be carrie d out in Chandigarh only. .
